questions.q: The girls don't go but the boys ____.
questions.zh: 女孩子不去，但男孩子去了。
questions.explain: “do”代替前面的“go”，以避免重複。

questions.q: My watch keeps good time, but his ____.
questions.zh: 我的錶很準，然而他的不準。
questions.explain:
① his = his watch
② doesn't = doesn't keep good time

questions.q: He said he didn't take the money, but I am sure he ____.
questions.zh: 他說他沒拿錢，然而我確信他拿了。
questions.explain: did = took the money（代指過去發生的動作）。

questions.q: I don't know whether he speaks Chinese or not, but he might ____.
questions.zh: 我不知道他會不會說中文，但他可能會說。
questions.explain: 用“do”代替“speak Chinese”，以避免重複。

questions.q: You had better ____ there again.
questions.zh: 你最好不要再去那裡了。
questions.explain: had better not + 原形 V 表示「最好不」。

questions.q: When the bell rang, he said he ____ better go and see who it was.
questions.zh: 當電鈴響時，他說他最好去看看是誰。
questions.explain: had better + 原形 V 表示「最好」。

questions.q: You ____ your lesson over the weekend, but you didn't.
questions.zh: 你本該在週末研讀你的功課，但你沒有。
questions.explain: should have + p.p.，表示「過去該做而未做」。

questions.q: He went away immediately lest he ____ see me.
questions.zh: 他立即走掉，以免看到我。
questions.explain: lest ~ should（惟恐；以免）

questions.q: I am sorry that you were late for the meeting. You ____ on time this morning.
questions.zh: 很遺憾你開會遲到，你今早應準時參加的。
questions.explain: ought to have + p.p.，表示「過去該做而未做」。

questions.q: You ought ____ your homework last night, but you didn't.
questions.zh: 你昨晚應將功課做好，但你沒有。
questions.explain: ought to (= should) + have + p.p. 表示「過去該做而未做…」。

questions.q: At any rate, we ____ be faithful to our friends. (複選)
questions.zh: 無論如何我們需對朋友忠誠。
questions.explain: (A)(B)(C)(D)皆為助動詞，其後皆可接原形動詞“be”。

questions.q: They would rather not ____ about it now.
questions.zh: 他們現在寧願不去談論這件事。
questions.explain: would rather + 原形 V 表示「寧願」。

questions.q: I would rather stay at home than ____ out.
questions.zh: 我寧願留在家裡也不願出去。
questions.explain: would rather A than B 表示「寧願 A 不願 B」，than 後接原形動詞。

questions.q: My brother used to ____ when he was a schoolboy.
questions.zh: 在我弟弟是學生時，他一直很膽小。
questions.explain: used to + 原形 V，而 timid（膽小的）為形容詞，需加“be”才可作主詞補語。

questions.q: I can't find my bag. It ____ stolen just now.
questions.zh: 我找不到我的包包，一定是剛剛被人偷走了。
questions.explain: must have been + p.p.，表示「對過去事實肯定的被動推測」。

questions.q: It ____, for the ground is wet.
questions.zh: 一定是下過雨，因為地面是濕的。
questions.explain: must have + p.p. 表示「對過去事實肯定的推測」。

questions.q: I ____ go to the station to pick up my friend now. (複選)
questions.zh: 我現在必須去車站接我的朋友。
questions.explain: 「必須」= must = have to = have got to。must 後接原形動詞，不可加 to。

questions.q:
It was necessary for her to go to Beijing last night.
= She ____ to go to Beijing last night.
questions.zh: 昨晚她必須去北京。
questions.explain: 表示「必須」，過去簡單式用 had to。

questions.q: We know that a housewife does not need ____ for food every day.
questions.zh: 我們知道，家庭主婦用不著每天上街買菜。
questions.explain:
① 此題的 need 不是助動詞，而是一般動詞，其否定如下：doesn't need to + 原形 V。
② 購物 = go shopping（shoping 拼法錯誤）。

questions.q: Judging from his accent, he ____ be a Frenchman.
questions.zh: 從他的口音判斷，他不可能使法國人。
questions.explain: can't + 原形 V，表示「不可能」。此空格亦可用 must（一定是）或 may（可能是）。

questions.q: I hope ____ to the party tonight.
questions.zh: 我希望今晚能來參加舞會。
questions.explain:
① 主詞 + hope + { to + V / that + 子句 }
② (B)(C)應改為 I shall be able to（助動詞後不能直接加 can，且 shall 後需接原形 be able to）。

questions.q: He said, "I must go now." = He said he ____ at once.
questions.zh: 他說：「我現在必須走了。」＝ 他說他必須立刻走。
questions.explain: must 的過去簡單式用 had to。

questions.q: A rich man ____ about his next meal.
questions.zh: 有錢人不必為下一餐發愁。
questions.explain: does not need to worry = need not worry（不必憂慮）。need 當一般動詞時，否定用 does not need to V；當助動詞時用 need not V。

questions.q: The child ought to ____ to bed earlier last night.
questions.zh: 這孩子昨晚應該早些（被）安置上床睡覺。
questions.explain: put ~ to bed 安置（孩子）睡覺。孩子是被安置上床，且指昨晚（過去），故用 ought to have been put。若選 (C)，則需改為主動的 have gone。

questions.q: The door ought to ____ a week ago.
questions.zh: 這扇門早在一週前就該修好了。
questions.explain: 門是被修理的，應用被動語態，而且發生於「過去（a week ago）」，所以用 ought to have been + p.p.。

questions.q: "What has happened to John?" "I don't know. He ____ lost."
questions.zh: 「約翰發生了什麼事？」「我不知道，他可能迷路了吧！」
questions.explain: may have + p.p.，表示「對過去可能的推測」。

questions.q: To keep the road as pleasant as possible, most of these trees ____ when the road is widened.
questions.zh: 為了保持道路儘可能令人舒適，當拓寬馬路時，大多數的樹木應被保留。
questions.explain:
① 樹是被保留，應用被動語態〔be + p.p.〕。
② should be + p.p.（應該被～）。

questions.q: Since they aren't answering their telephone, they ____.
questions.zh: 既然沒有人接電話，他們一定已經走了。
questions.explain: must have + p.p.，表示「對過去事實肯定的推測」。

questions.q: I am surprised that you ____ so indiscreetly.
questions.zh: 我很驚訝你竟然行事如此輕率。
questions.explain:
surprise 後之子句：
用 should + V ⇨ 表示現在或未來之「竟然」
用 should have + p.p. ⇨ 表示過去之「竟然」

questions.q: Every afternoon at three when Mary was about to start her violin lessons, I ____ go out for a walk. (複選)
questions.zh: 每天下午三點當瑪莉正要開始練小提琴時，我便習慣性地到外面散步。
questions.explain:
① would / used to + V 表示「（過去）習慣」。
② {be / get} used to + {V-ing / N} 表示「習慣於」。

questions.q: When driving, we ____ obey the traffic laws thoroughly and absolutely. (複選)
questions.zh: 開車時，我們應該〔必須〕完全而且絕對地遵守交通規則。
questions.explain:
① ought 後應接 to。
② need 用於肯定句時，為「一般動詞」，後應接 to。

questions.q: Oh, Jane, you've broken still another glass. You ought ____ when you washed it.
questions.zh: 哦！珍，你又打破杯子了。洗杯子時，你應該小心。
questions.explain: ought to / should + have + p.p. 表示「過去該～而事實沒有做到」。

questions.q:
John: Did you go anywhere after supper?
Mary: I ____, but I went to the movies instead.
questions.zh:
約翰：晚飯後有沒有到別的地方去？
瑪麗：我原本該讀書的，但我卻去看電影了。
questions.explain: should have + p.p. 表示過去該做而未做（同 32 題說明）。

questions.q:
"I expect you wonder why I've asked you to come back."
"Well, as a matter of fact, yes, I ____."
questions.zh:
「我想你一定想知道我為何要求你回來吧！」
「哦，是的。事實上我是很想知道原因。」
questions.explain: I do = I wonder（用助動詞 do 代替一般動詞 wonder）。

questions.q: That was a close call, you ____ hit by the car.
questions.zh: 真是千鈞一髮，你差點被車撞了。
questions.explain:
① 本題表示「與過去事實相反之假設」：could have been + p.p.（原本可能被…）。
② to have a close call = to have a narrow escape（千鈞一髮；僥倖脫險）。

questions.q: Mother has often admonished me that we cannot be ____ careful in this world.
questions.zh: 媽媽經常告誡我，我們在這個世界上要愈小心愈好。
questions.explain: cannot... too...（愈…愈好；再…也不為過）。

questions.q: Six o'clock will be too late to go, you ____ stay at home.
questions.zh: 六點鐘去太遲了，你最好待在家裡。
questions.explain: may as well = had better + 原形 V（最好；倒不如）。

questions.q: She ____ die than suffer disgrace.
questions.zh: 她寧死不受辱。
questions.explain: would rather + 原形 V + than + 原形 V（寧願…而不願…）。

questions.q:
Patrick: You may laugh, but I've been thinking of becoming a vegetarian.
Mary: Oh, Patrick, you ____ be out of your mind. You will be hungry all the time.
questions.zh:
派屈克：你可能會覺得好笑，但我一直想當個素食者。
瑪麗：哦，派屈克，你一定是瘋了，你會成天挨餓的。
questions.explain: must be（一定是）；may be（可能是）；can't be（不可能）。

questions.q:
"Hey!" Jack complained to the woman, "You said your dog doesn't bite!"
"It ____," the woman said, "but that's not my dog."
questions.zh:
「喂！」傑克向那婦女抱怨說：「你說你的狗不會咬人！」
「它是不咬人！」她說：「但那條狗不是我的。」
questions.explain: It doesn't = It doesn't (bite)（以助動詞 doesn't 代替 doesn't bite）。

sections.title: （三）翻譯填充題
sections.instructions: 依據中文提示，填入適當的英文字詞

questions.q:
一個人應該多多留意他自己的健康。
One ____ be ____ careful of one's health.
answer: cannot / too
can't / too
questions.zh: 一個人應該多多留意他自己的健康。
questions.explain: can't... too...（越…越好；無論…都不為過）。

questions.q:
你現在應該看書，不該看電視。
You should be studying ____ ____ watching TV.
answer: instead of
rather than
questions.zh: 你現在應該看書，不該看電視。
questions.explain: instead of（代替；不…反而…）或 rather than。

questions.q:
Everything scared me in those days, and still does.
那時候，件件事都會令我驚慌失措，____。
answer: 現在仍然如此。
現在仍然如此
questions.zh: 那時候，件件事都會令我驚慌失措，現在仍然如此。
questions.explain: and still does = and everything still scares me now。

questions.q:
If he persists in laziness, he might as well withdraw from school.
如果他堅持懈怠下去，____。
answer: 倒不如退學算了。
倒不如退學算了
questions.zh: 如果他堅持懈怠下去，倒不如退學算了。
questions.explain:
① persist in = insist on（堅持）
② might as well（最好；還不如）
③ withdraw from school（退學）。

questions.q:
The way our drivers drive, we cannot be too careful when crossing the streets.
我們司機那種開車方式，使我們過街時____。
answer: 要愈小心愈好。
要愈小心愈好
愈小心愈好。
questions.zh: 我們司機那種開車方式，使我們過街時要愈小心愈好。
questions.explain: cannot... too...（愈…愈好／無論多麼…都不為過）。

sections.title: （四）連貫式翻譯
sections.instructions: 將下列中文句子翻譯成英文

questions.q: 我常聽到人們抱怨薪水太少，不夠花。
questions.hint: ① 抱怨：complain ② 薪水：salary
answer: I often hear people complain that their salaries are too small to meet their demands.
I often hear people complain that their salaries are too small to meet their desires.
I often hear people complain that their salaries are too small to meet their wishes.
questions.zh: 我常聽到人們抱怨薪水太少，不夠花。
questions.explain:
① too + 形/副 + to V（太…而無法…）
② meet one's demand（滿足…之需求）

questions.q: 坦白地說，他們不該用錢來衡量一切。
questions.hint: 衡量一切：judge everything by + N
answer: Frankly speaking, they shouldn't see things in terms of money.
Frankly speaking, they shouldn't judge everything by money.
questions.zh: 坦白地說，他們不該用錢來衡量一切。
questions.explain:
① Frankly speaking（坦白說）／ Generally speaking（一般說來）／ Strictly speaking（嚴格地說）
② in terms of（自…角度；以…觀點）

questions.q: 金錢買不到像健康、友誼、知識等這樣寶貴東西。
answer: Money can't buy such precious things as health, friendship, knowledge, etc.
Money can't buy precious things such as health, friendship, knowledge, and so on.
questions.zh: 金錢買不到像健康、友誼、知識等這樣寶貴東西。
questions.explain:
① such + 名詞 + as（像…的東西）
② such as = like（如／像）

questions.q: 然而，沒有錢的話，我們也無法過快樂的生活。
questions.hint: 過快樂的生活：live/lead a happy life
answer: However, we couldn't lead a happy life without money.
However, we couldn't live happily without money.
questions.zh: 然而，沒有錢的話，我們也無法過快樂的生活。
questions.explain: However = Nevertheless = In spite of the fact（雖然；儘管如此）

questions.q: 金錢是否重要，須看個人的人生觀而定。
questions.hint: ① 須看…而定：depend on ② 人生觀：philosophy of life
answer: Whether money is important or not depends on one's philosophy of life.
It depends on one's philosophy of life whether money is important or not.
questions.zh: 金錢是否重要，須看個人的人生觀而定。
questions.explain:
〔whether A or B〕+ V (單數形式)：「是否」名詞子句作主詞
= It + V... 〔whether A or B〕名詞子句作真正主詞

sections.title: （五）選答案測驗
sections.instructions:
閱讀短文，並根據上下文在空格內填入最適當的單字：

When you look at our planet from space as the astronauts 1. ____, you might wonder why our planet is called e____ 2. . "Planet Water" m____ 3. be a better name. About three-fourths of the earth's surface is covered by water. Most of this water is the salt water f____ 4. d in the oceans. The water in rivers, lakes, ponds, and springs 5. ____ fresh water.
Most l____ 6. g things are found in or near water. Some of them live in the lakes, ponds, and oceans. O____ 7. need only to be near water. A few live in areas, such as desert, w____ 8. they go without water for a long period of time. All living things contain water in the bodies. Your own body, 9. ____ instance, is about two-thirds water. This water is essential for life. It is needed 10. ____ carry on all the life activities.

【詞彙及短語提示】
1. astronauts [ˈæstrənɔːts] 名 太空人
2. wonder [ˈwʌndər] 動 想知道；對…感到好奇
3. earth's surface 地球表面
4. is covered by 被…所覆蓋
5. such as desert 如沙漠地區
6. go without water a long period of time 長期過著缺水的生活
7. be essential for 對…是必要的；對…是必需的
8. carry on all the life activities 維持（續）人生的一切活動

questions.q: When you look at our planet from space as the astronauts 1. ____, ...
questions.zh: 當你如同太空人那樣從太空中注視我們的行星時，...
questions.explain: do = look at（注視；看著），助動詞 do/does/did 可用來代替前面已提過之一般動詞。

questions.q: ... you might wonder why our planet is called e____ 2. .
questions.zh: ... 你可能想知道為何我們的行星被稱為地球。
questions.explain:
① 本句意思「你可能想知道為何我們的行星被稱為地球。」
② planet 名 行星

questions.q: "Planet Water" m____ 3. be a better name.
questions.zh: 「水星球」或許是個更好的名字。
questions.explain:
① 本題為假設語氣，故用過去簡單式 might，表示與目前的事實相反。
② "Planet Water" might be a better name.（稱呼我們的星球為「水星球」，名字更恰當。）

questions.q: Most of this water is the salt water f____ 4. d in the oceans.
questions.zh: 這些水絕大部分是海洋中發現的鹹水。
questions.explain:
... the salt water [which is found in the oceans].
= ... the salt water found in the oceans（分詞片語修飾名詞 salt water）。

questions.q: The water in rivers, lakes, ponds, and springs 5. ____ fresh water.
questions.zh: 河流、湖泊、池塘和泉水中的水是淡水。
questions.explain: 本句主詞為不可數名詞 The water，故動詞用單數形式 is。

questions.q: Most l____ 6. g things are found in or near water.
questions.zh: 大多數生物都生活在水裡或水邊。
questions.explain: living things = creatures（生物）。

questions.q: Some of them live in the lakes, ponds, and oceans. O____ 7. need only to be near water.
questions.zh: 牠們有些生活在湖泊、池塘和海洋中。其他生物則只需要靠近水。
questions.explain: Some + V..., Others + V...（有些…，有些…／其他…）。

questions.q: A few live in areas, such as desert, w____ 8. they go without water for a long period of time.
questions.zh: 少數生活在像沙漠這樣的地區，在那裡牠們長期過著缺水的生活。
questions.explain: 表示地點的關係副詞用 where，指先行詞 desert（沙漠地區）。

questions.q: Your own body, 9. ____ instance, is about two-thirds water.
questions.zh: 例如你自己身體，大約有三分之二是水。
questions.explain: for instance = for example（例如；舉例來說）。

questions.q: It is needed 10. ____ carry on all the life activities.
questions.zh: 需要它來維持生命的一切活動。
questions.explain: be needed to + V（被需要用來…）。
